EmojiCompat font provider not available on this device.
EmojiCompat is not initialized.

You must initialize EmojiCompat prior to referencing the EmojiCompat instance.

The most likely cause of this error is disabling the EmojiCompatInitializer
either explicitly in AndroidManifest.xml, or by including
androidx.emoji2:emoji2-bundled.

Automatic initialization is typically performed by EmojiCompatInitializer. If
you are not expecting to initialize EmojiCompat manually in your application,
please check to ensure it has not been removed from your APK's manifest. You can
do this in Android Studio using Build > Analyze APK.

In the APK Analyzer, ensure that the startup entry for
EmojiCompatInitializer and InitializationProvider is present in
 AndroidManifest.xml. If it is missing or contains tools:node="remove", and you
intend to use automatic configuration, verify:

  1. Your application does not include emoji2-bundled
  2. All modules do not contain an exclusion manifest rule for
     EmojiCompatInitializer or InitializationProvider. For more information
     about manifest exclusions see the documentation for the androidx startup
     library.

If you intend to use emoji2-bundled, please call EmojiCompat.init. You can
learn more in the documentation for BundledEmojiCompatConfig.

If you intended to perform manual configuration, it is recommended that you call
EmojiCompat.init immediately on application startup.

If you still cannot resolve this issue, please open a bug with your specific
configuration to help improve error message.

    function sendScroll() {
        try {
            var totalH = document.body.scrollHeight || document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
            var clientH = window.innerHeight || document.documentElement.clientHeight;
            var scrollH = document.body.scrollTop || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
            var validH = scrollH + clientH;
            var result = (validH / totalH * 100).toFixed(2);
            console.log('LandingPageLogscroll status: (' + scrollH + '+' + clientH + ')/' + totalH + '=' + result);
            window.JS_LANDING_PAGE_LOG_OBJ.readPercent(result);
        } catch (e) {
            console.log('sendScroll error' + e)
        }
    }
sendScroll();

    sendScroll();

uniform float blend;
varying vec2 vTexCoord;
void main() {
  vec3 cur = texture2D(curTex, vTexCoord).rgb;
  vec3 prev = texture2D(prevTex, vTexCoord).rgb;
  
  // 静止检测：差异极小直接输出当前帧，避免模糊
  float staticDiff = dot(abs(cur - prev), vec3(1.0));
  if (staticDiff < 0.02) {
    gl_FragColor = vec4(cur, 1.0);
    return;
  }
  
  // 搜索最佳偏移 (±2像素，适应GBA放大后纹理)
  float bestDiff = 1.0;
  vec2 bestOffset = vec2(0.0);
  for (int dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
    for (int dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
      vec2 offset = vec2(float(dx), float(dy)) * texSize;
      vec3 s = texture2D(prevTex, vTexCoord + offset).rgb;
      float diff = dot(abs(cur - s), vec3(1.0));
      if (diff < bestDiff) {
        bestDiff = diff;
        bestOffset = offset;
      }
    }
  }
  
  // 单向正确warp：中间帧 t=blend
  vec3 fromPrev = texture2D(prevTex, vTexCoord + bestOffset * blend).rgb;
  vec3 fromCur  = texture2D(curTex,  vTexCoord - bestOffset * blend).rgb;
  
  // 双向一致性信任度
  float consist = dot(abs(fromPrev - fromCur), vec3(1.0));
  float trust = 1.0 - clamp(consist * 0.5, 0.0, 1.0);
  
  // 合成：光流混合，不可信时回退当前帧（不回退简单平均）
  vec3 flowMixed = mix(fromPrev, fromCur, blend);
  vec3 outColor = mix(cur, flowMixed, trust);
  
  gl_FragColor = vec4(outColor, 1.0);
}

precision mediump float;
uniform sampler2D rubyTexture;
varying vec2 vTexCoord;
void main() {
gl_FragColor = texture2D(rubyTexture, vTexCoord);
}

    var isNullOrEmpty = function(param) {
        return param === null || param === undefined;
    };
    var EVENTS = mraid.EVENTS = {
        error: 'error',
        info: 'info',
        ready: 'ready',
        viewableChange: 'viewableChange',
        sizeChange: 'sizeChange',
        exposureChange: 'exposureChange',
        playStateChanged: 'playStateChanged',
        loadStateChanged: 'loadStateChanged',
        currentTime: 'currentTime',
        playEnd: 'playEnd',
        pageChanged: 'pageChanged',
        downloadStateChanged: 'downloadStateChanged',
        safeAreaInsetsChange: 'safeAreaInsetsChange',
    };

    bridge.setScreenSize = function (val) {
       if (screenSize.width != val.width || screenSize.height != val.height) {
            screenSize = val;
            broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.sizeChange, val.width, val.height);
        }
    };
    bridge.setIsViewable = function (val) {
        if ((val ^ isViewable) == 1) {
            isViewable = val;
            broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.viewableChange, isViewable)
        }
    };
    bridge.setExposureChange = function (val) {
        if (val != exposure) {
            exposure = val;
            broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.exposureChange, val)
        }
    };
    bridge.setBindData = function (val) { bindData = val; };
    bridge.sdkVersion = function (val) { sdkVersion = val; }
    bridge.orientation = function (val) { currentAppOrientation = val; }
    bridge.onStorageChanged = function (evt) {
        const key = 'storage_' + evt.key;
        broadcastEvent(listeners, key, evt);
    };
    bridge.setBidResponse = function (val) {
        bidResponse = val;
    };
    bridge.onChangeEvent = function(evt) {
        broadcastEvent(listeners, evt.event, evt.data);
    };
    bridge.setvdReadyToPlay = function (val) {
        let vpaid = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]
        broadcastEvent(vpaid.handlers, EVENTS.ready, val);
    };
    bridge.setvdPlayStateChanged = function (val) {
        let vpaid = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]
        broadcastEvent(vpaid.handlers, EVENTS.playStateChanged, val);
    };
    bridge.setvdLoadStateChanged = function (val) {
        let vpaid = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]
        broadcastEvent(vpaid.handlers, EVENTS.loadStateChanged, val);
    };
    bridge.setvdPlayCurrentTime = function (val) {
        let vpaid = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]

    };
    bridge.setvdPlayToEnd = function (val) {
        let vpaid = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]
        broadcastEvent(vpaid.handlers, EVENTS.playEnd, val);
    };
    bridge.setvdPlayError = function (val) {
        let vpaid = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]
        broadcastEvent(vpaid.handlers, EVENTS.error, val);
    };
    bridge.onChangeFired = function (val) {
        let obj = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId];
        broadcastEvent(obj.handlers, val.event, val.args);
    };
    bridge.notify = function (val) {
        console.log(val)
        if (val.event.startsWith('fire_')) {
            broadcastEvent(listeners, val.event)
            return
        }

        if (val.event.startsWith('dispatch_')) {
            broadcastEvent(listeners, val.event)
            mraid.removeEventListener(val.event);
            return
        }

        if (val.event.startsWith('animation_')) {
            broadcastEvent(listeners, val.event)
            mraid.removeEventListener(val.event);
            return
        }

        broadcastEvent(listeners, val.event, val.message)
        mraid.removeEventListener(val.event);
    };
    bridge.notifyPageChangeEvent = function (val) {
        broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.pageChanged, val)
    };
    bridge.notifyApkDownloadStateEvent = function (val) {
        broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.downloadStateChanged, val)
    };
    bridge.setWVFinished = function (val) {
        let web = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]
        broadcastEvent(web.handlers, EVENTS.ready);
    };
    bridge.setWVError = function (val) {
        let web = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]
        broadcastEvent(web.handlers, EVENTS.error, val.error);
    };
    bridge.postMessage = function (msg) {
        var msgStr = JSON.stringify(msg);
        sigandroid.postMessage(msgStr);
    }
    bridge.syncMessage = function (msg) {
        if (this.nativeCallInFlight) {
            this.nativeCallQueue.push(msg)
        } else {
            this.nativeCallInFlight = true;
            var msgStr = JSON.stringify(msg);
            sigandroid.postMessage(msgStr);
        }
    }
    bridge.nativeCallComplete = function (command) {
        console.log('nativeCallCompletecommand = ' + command)
        if (this.nativeCallQueue.length === 0) {
            this.nativeCallInFlight = false;
            return
        }
        var nextCall = this.nativeCallQueue.shift();
        bridge.postMessage(nextCall);
    };
    bridge.onMotionChanged = function (evt) {
        const key = 'motion_' + evt.type+evt.event;
        delete evt.type;
        delete evt.event;
        broadcastEvent(listeners, key, evt);
    };
    var changeHandlers = {
        onChangeEvent: bridge.onChangeEvent,
        vdReadyToPlay: bridge.setvdReadyToPlay,
        vdPlayStateChanged: bridge.setvdPlayStateChanged,
        vdLoadStateChanged: bridge.setvdLoadStateChanged,

        sdkVersion: bridge.sdkVersion,
        orientation: bridge.orientation,
        storageChanged: bridge.onStorageChanged,
        bidResponse: bridge.setBidResponse,
        notify: bridge.notify,
        motionChanged: bridge.onMotionChanged,
        onChangeFired: bridge.onChangeFired,
    };
    bridge.fireChangeEvent = function (properties) {
        for (let p in properties) {
            if (properties.hasOwnProperty(p)) {
                let handler = changeHandlers[p];
                try {
                    handler(properties[p])
                } catch (error) {
                    console.log('error: ' + error.message);
                }
            }
        }
    };

    var Storage = function (type) {
        this.setItem = function (key, value) {
            sigandroid.storage(JSON.stringify({ event: 'setItem', args: { type, key, value } }))
        };
        this.getItem = function (key) {
            var result = sigandroid.storage(JSON.stringify({ event: 'getItem', args: { type, key } }));
            return result
        };
        this.removeItem = function (key) {
            sigandroid.storage(JSON.stringify({ event: 'removeItem', args: { type, key } }))
        };
        this.clear = function () {
            sigandroid.storage(JSON.stringify({ event: 'clear', args: { type } }))
        };
        this.length = function () {
            var result = sigandroid.storage(JSON.stringify({ event: 'length', args: { type } }));
            return parseInt(result)
        };
        this.addEventListener = function (key, callback) {
            sigandroid.storage(JSON.stringify({ event: 'addEventListener', args: { type, key } }))
            mraid.addEventListener('storage_' + key, callback);
        };
    };
    var EventListeners = function (event) {
        this.event = event;
        this.count = 0;
        var listeners = {};
        this.add = function (func) {
            var id = String(func);
            if (!listeners[id]) {
                listeners[id] = func;
                this.count++
            }
        };
        this.remove = function (func) {
            var id = String(func);
            if (listeners[id]) {
                listeners[id] = null;
                delete listeners[id];
                this.count--;
                return true
            } else {
                return false
            }
        };
        this.removeAll = function () {
            for (var id in listeners) {
                if (listeners.hasOwnProperty(id)) this.remove(listeners[id])
            }
        };
        this.broadcast = function (args) {
            for (var id in listeners) {
                if (listeners.hasOwnProperty(id)) listeners[id].apply(mraid, args)
            }
        };
        this.toString = function () {
            var out = [event, ':'];
            for (var id in listeners) {
                if (listeners.hasOwnProperty(id)) out.push('|', id, '|')
            }
            return out.join('')
        }
    };
    var contains = function (value, array) {
        if (value.indexOf('motion_') == 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (value.indexOf('storage_') == 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (value.indexOf('fire_') == 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (value.indexOf('dispatch_') == 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (value.indexOf('animation_') == 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (value.indexOf('open_') == 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (value.indexOf('lance_') == 0) {
            return true;
        }

        for (var i in array) {
            if (array[i] === value) return true
        }
        return false
    };
    var broadcastEvent = function () {
        var args = new Array(arguments.length);
        var l = arguments.length;
        for (var i = 0; i < l; i++) args[i] = arguments[i];
        var handlers = args.shift();
        var event = args.shift();
        if (handlers[event]) {
            handlers[event].broadcast(args)
        }
    };
    var addEventListener = function (handlers, event, listener) {
        if (!event || !listener) {
            broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.error, 'Both event and listener are required.', 'addEventListener')
        } else {
            if (!handlers[event]) {
                handlers[event] = new EventListeners(event)
            }
            handlers[event].add(listener)
        }
    };
    var removeEventListener = function (funs, event, listener) {
        if (!event) {
            broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.error, 'Event is required.', 'removeEventListener');
            return
        }
        if (listener) {
            var success = false;
            if (funs[event]) {
                success = funs[event].remove(listener)
            }
            if (!success) {
                broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.error, 'Listener not currently registered for event.', 'removeEventListener');
                return
            }
        } else if (funs && funs[event]) {
            funs[event].removeAll()
        }
        if (funs[event] && funs[event].count === 0) {
            funs[event] = null;
            delete funs[event]
        }
    };

    function callNativeFunc(kwargs, func) {
        if (kwargs === undefined) return undefined;
        if (func === undefined) return undefined;
        kwargs['func'] = func;
        var returnStr = sigandroid.func(JSON.stringify(kwargs));
        if (returnStr) {
            try {
                return JSON.parse(returnStr)
            } catch (e) {
                return JSON.stringify(returnStr)
            }
        } else {
            console.log('-------callNativeFunc return null-----');
        }
    };

   mraid.subscribe = function(uniqId, event, listener) {
        if (isNullOrEmpty(uniqId) || isNullOrEmpty(event)) {
            broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.error, 'Both event and uniqId are required.', 'subscribe');
            return;
        }
        let key = uniqId + '~' + event;
        addEventListener(listeners, key, listener);
        if (listeners[key] && listeners[key].count == 1) {
            bridge.syncMessage({ event: 'subscribe', args: { uniqId, event } });
        }
    };
    mraid.unsubscribe = function(uniqId, event, listener) {
        if (isNullOrEmpty(uniqId) || isNullOrEmpty(event)) {
            broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.error, 'Both event and uniqId are required.', 'unsubscribe');
            return;
        }
        let key = uniqId + '~' + event;
        removeEventListener(listeners, key, listener);
        if (isNullOrEmpty(listeners[key])) {
            bridge.syncMessage({ event: 'unsubscribe', args: { uniqId, event } });
        }
    };

     var sendCustomEvent = function() {
         var args = new Array();
         var l = arguments.length;
         for (var i = 0; i < l; i++) {
             var obj = arguments[i];
             if (obj === null) continue;
             if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
                 args = args.concat(obj)
             } else {
                 args.push(obj)
             }
         }
         args.unshift('event');
         args.unshift('smextension');
         executeNativeCall(args)
     };
     var executeNativeCall = function(args) {
         var command = args.shift();
         var call = 'xxx://' + command;
         var key, value;
         var isFirstArgument = true;
         for (var i = 0; i < args.length; i += 2) {
             key = args[i];
             value = args[i + 1];
             if (value === null) continue;
             if (isFirstArgument) {
                 call += '?';
                 isFirstArgument = false
             } else {
                 call += '&'
             }
             call += encodeURIComponent(key) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(value)
         }
         iframeSendSrc(call)
     };
     var iframeSendSrc = function(src) {
         var iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
         iframe.setAttribute('src', src);
         document.documentElement.appendChild(iframe);
         iframe.parentNode.removeChild(iframe);
         iframe = null
     }

     var EventListeners = function(event) {
         this.event = event;
         this.count = 0;
         var listeners = {};
         this.add = function(func) {
             var id = String(func);
             if (!listeners[id]) {
                 listeners[id] = func;
                 this.count++
             }
         };
         this.remove = function(func) {
             var id = String(func);
             if (listeners[id]) {
                 listeners[id] = null;
                 delete listeners[id];
                 this.count--;
                 return true
             } else {
                 return false
             }
         };
         this.removeAll = function() {
             for (var id in listeners) {
                 if (listeners.hasOwnProperty(id)) this.remove(listeners[id])
             }
         };
         this.broadcast = function(args) {
             for (var id in listeners) {
                 if (listeners.hasOwnProperty(id)) listeners[id].apply(mraid, args)
             }
         };
         this.toString = function() {
             var out = [event, ':'];
             for (var id in listeners) {
                 if (listeners.hasOwnProperty(id)) out.push('|', id, '|')
             }
             return out.join('')
         }

     xxx.removeEventListener = function(event, listener) {
         if (!event) {
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'Event is required.', 'removeEventListener');
             return
         }
         if (listener) {
             var success = false;
             if (listeners[event]) {
                 success = listeners[event].remove(listener)
             }
             if (!success) {
                 broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'Listener not currently registered for event.', 'removeEventListener');
                 return
             }

             listeners[event] = null;
             delete listeners[event]
         }

     bridge.nativeCallComplete = function(command) {
         console.dclog('nativeCallCompletecommand = ' + command)
         if (this.nativeCallQueue.length === 0) {
             this.nativeCallInFlight = false;
             return
         }
         var nextCall = this.nativeCallQueue.pop();
         window.location.href = nextCall

     bridge.executeNativeCall = function(args) {
         var command = args.shift();
         if (!this.nativeSDKFiredReady) {
             console.dclog('rejecting ' + command + ' because mraid is not ready');
             bridge.notifyErrorEvent('mraid is not ready', command);
             return
         }
         var call = 'mraid://' + command;
         var key, value;
         var isFirstArgument = true;
         for (var i = 0; i < args.length; i += 2) {
             key = args[i];
             value = args[i + 1];
             if (value === null) continue;
             if (isFirstArgument) {
                 call += '?';
                 isFirstArgument = false
             } else {
                 call += '&'
             }
             call += encodeURIComponent(key) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(value)
         }
         if (this.nativeCallInFlight) {
             this.nativeCallQueue.push(call)
         } else {
             this.nativeCallInFlight = true;
             window.location = call
         }
     };

     var stringify = function(obj) {
         if (typeof obj === 'object') {
             var out = [];
             if (obj.push) {
                 for (var p in obj) out.push(obj[p]);
                 return '[' + out.join(',') + ']'
             } else {
                 for (var p in obj) out.push("'" + p + "': " + obj[p]);
                 return '{' + out.join(',') + '}'
             }
         } else return String(obj)
     };

     var validate = function(obj, validators, action, merge) {
         if (!merge) {
             if (obj === null) {
                 broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'Required object not provided.', action);
                 return false
             } else {
                 for (var i in validators) {
                     if (validators.hasOwnProperty(i) && obj[i] === undefined) {
                         broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'Object is missing required property: ' + i, action);
                         return false
                     }
                 }
             }
         }
         for (var prop in obj) {
             var validator = validators[prop];
             var value = obj[prop];
             if (validator && !validator(value)) {
                 broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'Value of property ' + prop + ' is invalid: ' + value, action);
                 return false
             }
         }
         return true
     };

    var addEventListener = function(handlers, event, listener) {
        if (!event || !listener) {
            broadcastEvent(EVENTS.error, 'Both event and listener are required.', 'addEventListener')
        } else {
            if (!handlers[event]) {
                handlers[event] = new EventListeners(event)

        }

    var removeEventListener = function(funs, event, listener) {
        if (!event) {
            broadcastEvent(EVENTS.error, 'Event is required.', 'removeEventListener');
            return
        }
        if (listener) {
            var success = false;
            if (funs[event]) {
                success = funs[event].remove(listener)
            }
            if (!success) {
                broadcastEvent(EVENTS.error, 'Listener not currently registered for event.', 'removeEventListener');
                return
            }
        } else if (funs && funs[event]) {
            console.log('removeAll -- ' + event);
            funs[event].removeAll()
        }
        if (funs[event] && funs[event].count === 0) {
            funs[event] = null;
            delete funs[event]
        }
    };

     mraid.open = function(URL) {
         var args = new Array();
         var l = arguments.length;
         for (var i = 0; i < l; i++) {
             var obj = arguments[i];
             args.push(obj)
         }
         args.shift();
         if (!URL) broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'URL is required.', 'open');
         else {
             var ln = args.length;
             if (ln == 0) bridge.executeNativeCall(['open', 'url', URL]);
             var ext = args[ln - 1];
             bridge.executeNativeCall(['open', 'url', URL, 'ext', JSON.stringify(ext)])
         }
     };
     mraid.removeEventListener = function(event, listener) {
         if (!event) {
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'Event is required.', 'removeEventListener');
             return
         }
         if (listener) {
             var success = false;
             if (listeners[event]) {
                 success = listeners[event].remove(listener)
             }
             if (!success) {
                 broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'Listener not currently registered for event.', 'removeEventListener');
                 return
             }
         } else if (!listener && listeners[event]) {
             listeners[event].removeAll()
         }
         if (listeners[event] && listeners[event].count === 0) {
             listeners[event] = null;
             delete listeners[event]
         }
     };

     var CalendarEventParser = {
         initialize: function(parameters) {
             this.parameters = parameters;
             this.errors = [];
             this.arguments = ['createCalendarEvent']
         },
         parse: function() {
             if (!this.parameters) {
                 this.errors.push('The object passed to createCalendarEvent cannot be null.')
             } else {
                 this.parseDescription();
                 this.parseLocation();
                 this.parseSummary();
                 this.parseStartAndEndDates();
                 this.parseReminder();
                 this.parseRecurrence();
                 this.parseTransparency()
             }
             var errorCount = this.errors.length;
             if (errorCount) {
                 this.arguments.length = 0
             }
             return (errorCount === 0)
         },
         parseDescription: function() {
             this._processStringValue('description')
         },
         parseLocation: function() {
             this._processStringValue('location')
         },
         parseSummary: function() {
             this._processStringValue('summary')
         },
         parseStartAndEndDates: function() {
             this._processDateValue('start');
             this._processDateValue('end')
         },
         parseReminder: function() {
             var reminder = this._getParameter('reminder');
             if (!reminder) {
                 return
             }
             if (reminder < 0) {
                 this.arguments.push('relativeReminder');
                 this.arguments.push(parseInt(reminder) / 1000)
             } else {
                 this.arguments.push('absoluteReminder');
                 this.arguments.push(reminder)
             }
         },
         parseRecurrence: function() {
             var recurrenceDict = this._getParameter('recurrence');
             if (!recurrenceDict) {
                 return
             }
             this.parseRecurrenceInterval(recurrenceDict);
             this.parseRecurrenceFrequency(recurrenceDict);
             this.parseRecurrenceEndDate(recurrenceDict);
             this.parseRecurrenceArrayValue(recurrenceDict, 'daysInWeek');
             this.parseRecurrenceArrayValue(recurrenceDict, 'daysInMonth');
             this.parseRecurrenceArrayValue(recurrenceDict, 'daysInYear');
             this.parseRecurrenceArrayValue(recurrenceDict, 'monthsInYear')
         },
         parseTransparency: function() {
             var validValues = ['opaque', 'transparent'];
             if (this.parameters.hasOwnProperty('transparency')) {
                 var transparency = this.parameters.transparency;
                 if (contains(transparency, validValues)) {
                     this.arguments.push('transparency');
                     this.arguments.push(transparency)
                 } else {
                     this.errors.push('transparency must be opaque or transparent')
                 }
             }
         },
         parseRecurrenceArrayValue: function(recurrenceDict, kind) {
             if (recurrenceDict.hasOwnProperty(kind)) {
                 var array = recurrenceDict[kind];
                 if (!array || !(array instanceof Array)) {
                     this.errors.push(kind + ' must be an array.')
                 } else {
                     var arrayStr = array.join(',');
                     this.arguments.push(kind);
                     this.arguments.push(arrayStr)
                 }
             }
         },
         parseRecurrenceInterval: function(recurrenceDict) {
             if (recurrenceDict.hasOwnProperty('interval')) {
                 var interval = recurrenceDict.interval;
                 if (!interval) {
                     this.errors.push('Recurrence interval cannot be null.')
                 } else {
                     this.arguments.push('interval');
                     this.arguments.push(interval)
                 }
             } else {
                 this.arguments.push('interval');
                 this.arguments.push(1)
             }
         },
         parseRecurrenceFrequency: function(recurrenceDict) {
             if (recurrenceDict.hasOwnProperty('frequency')) {
                 var frequency = recurrenceDict.frequency;
                 var validFrequencies = ['daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'yearly'];
                 if (contains(frequency, validFrequencies)) {
                     this.arguments.push('frequency');
                     this.arguments.push(frequency)
                 } else {
                     this.errors.push('Recurrence frequency must be one of: "daily", "weekly", "monthly", "yearly".')
                 }
             }
         },
         parseRecurrenceEndDate: function(recurrenceDict) {
             var expires = recurrenceDict.expires;
             if (!expires) {
                 return
             }
             this.arguments.push('expires');
             this.arguments.push(expires)
         },
         _getParameter: function(key) {
             if (this.parameters.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
                 return this.parameters[key]
             }
             return null
         },
         _processStringValue: function(kind) {
             if (this.parameters.hasOwnProperty(kind)) {
                 var value = this.parameters[kind];
                 this.arguments.push(kind);
                 this.arguments.push(value)
             }
         },
         _processDateValue: function(kind) {
             if (this.parameters.hasOwnProperty(kind)) {
                 var dateString = this._getParameter(kind);
                 this.arguments.push(kind);
                 this.arguments.push(dateString)
             }
         }
     }

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS FileDownloadResponseFilename( url VARCHAR NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, filename VARCHAR NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS block( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, breakpoint_id INTEGER, block_index INTEGER, start_offset INTEGER, content_length INTEGER, current_offset INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS breakpoint( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, url VARCHAR NOT NULL, etag VARCHAR, parent_path VARCHAR NOT NULL, filename VARCHAR, task_only_parent_path TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0, chunked TINYINT(1) DEFAULT 0)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS click_event(_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,ad_id INTEGER,req_id TEXT,time INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS downloadChunk( _id INTEGER, chunkIndex INTEGER, startOffset INTEGER, curOffset INTEGER, endOffset INTEGER, chunkContentLen INTEGER, hostChunkIndex INTEGER )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS downloader( _id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, url TEXT, savePath TEXT, tempPath TEXT, name TEXT, chunkCount INTEGER, status INTEGER, curBytes INTEGER, totalBytes INTEGER, eTag TEXT, onlyWifi INTEGER, force INTEGER, retryCount INTEGER, extra TEXT, mimeType TEXT, title TEXT, notificationEnable INTEGER, notificationVisibility INTEGER, isFirstDownload INTEGER, isFirstSuccess INTEGER, needHttpsToHttpRetry INTEGER, downloadTime INTEGER, packageName TEXT, md5 TEXT, retryDelay INTEGER, curRetryTime INTEGER, retryDelayStatus INTEGER, defaultHttpServiceBackUp INTEGER, chunkRunnableReuse INTEGER, retryDelayTimeArray TEXT, chunkDowngradeRetry INTEGER, backUpUrlsStr TEXT, backUpUrlRetryCount INTEGER, realDownloadTime INTEGER, retryScheduleMinutes INTEGER, independentProcess INTEGER, auxiliaryJsonobjectString TEXT, iconUrl TEXT, appVersionCode INTEGER, taskId TEXT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ksad_actions (actionId varchar(60) primary key, aLog TEXT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ksad_block_actions (actionId varchar(60) primary key, aLog TEXT)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS segments( _id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,info TEXT )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS taskFileDirty( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE SourceInfo (_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,url TEXT NOT NULL,mime TEXT,length INTEGER);
CREATE TABLE adload_cache_event (  adslot_id text primary key, media_request_count integer ,media_ready_count integer ,pre_req_time integer , req_interval_time integer ,req_pool_size integer); 

CREATE TABLE adload_event ( id integer primary key AUTOINCREMENT , adslot_id text  , error_code integer ,timestamp integer  );

CREATE TABLE adload_ready_event (  adslot_id text primary key, media_request_count integer ,media_ready_count integer ); 

CREATE TABLE ads ( endcard_md5 text  ,video_md5 text  ,ad blob  ,ad_source_channel text  ,ad_type integer  ,create_time integer  ,crid text  ,load_id text  ,adTrackersMap blob  ,adslot_id text  ,camp_id text  ,request_id text , primary key ( crid ,adslot_id) ); 

CREATE TABLE file_reference ( endcard_md5 blob  ,video_md5 blob  ,crid text  ,adslot_id text  , primary key ( crid ,adslot_id ) );

CREATE TABLE tracks ( id integer primary key AUTOINCREMENT ,retryNum integer   ,source text   ,event text   ,request_id text   ,url text   ,timestamp integer   );

CREATE TRIGGER trigger_delete after delete on ads begin delete from file_reference where crid = old.crid  and adslot_id == old.adslot_id; end;

CREATE TRIGGER trigger_insert after insert on ads begin insert or replace into file_reference (crid,adslot_id,video_md5,endcard_md5) values(new.crid,new.adslot_id,new.video_md5,new.endcard_md5) ; end;

javascript:(function () {
    var uniqueId = 1;
    var mraid = window.mraid = {};
    var bridge = window.mraidbridge = {
        nativeCallQueue: [],
        nativeCallInFlight: false,
        queue: {},
    };
    var bidResponse = {};
    var bindData = undefined;
    var isViewable = false;
    var exposure = 0;
    var sdkVersion = undefined;
    var listeners = {};
    var screenSize = {
        width: 0,
        height: 0
    };
    var currentAppOrientation = {
        orientation: 0,
        locked: true
    };
    var isNullOrEmpty = function(param) {
        return param === null || param === undefined;
    };
    var EVENTS = mraid.EVENTS = {
        error: 'error',
        info: 'info',
        ready: 'ready',
        viewableChange: 'viewableChange',
        sizeChange: 'sizeChange',
        exposureChange: 'exposureChange',
        playStateChanged: 'playStateChanged',
        loadStateChanged: 'loadStateChanged',
        currentTime: 'currentTime',
        playEnd: 'playEnd',
        pageChanged: 'pageChanged',
        downloadStateChanged: 'downloadStateChanged',
        safeAreaInsetsChange: 'safeAreaInsetsChange',
    };

    bridge.setScreenSize = function (val) {
       if (screenSize.width != val.width || screenSize.height != val.height) {
            screenSize = val;
            broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.sizeChange, val.width, val.height);
        }
    };
    bridge.setIsViewable = function (val) {
        if ((val ^ isViewable) == 1) {
            isViewable = val;
            broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.viewableChange, isViewable)
        }
    };
    bridge.setExposureChange = function (val) {
        if (val != exposure) {
            exposure = val;
            broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.exposureChange, val)
        }
    };
    bridge.setBindData = function (val) { bindData = val; };
    bridge.sdkVersion = function (val) { sdkVersion = val; }
    bridge.orientation = function (val) { currentAppOrientation = val; }
    bridge.onStorageChanged = function (evt) {
        const key = 'storage_' + evt.key;
        broadcastEvent(listeners, key, evt);
    };
    bridge.setBidResponse = function (val) {
        bidResponse = val;
    };
    bridge.onChangeEvent = function(evt) {
        broadcastEvent(listeners, evt.event, evt.data);
    };
    bridge.setvdReadyToPlay = function (val) {
        let vpaid = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]
        broadcastEvent(vpaid.handlers, EVENTS.ready, val);
    };
    bridge.setvdPlayStateChanged = function (val) {
        let vpaid = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]
        broadcastEvent(vpaid.handlers, EVENTS.playStateChanged, val);
    };
    bridge.setvdLoadStateChanged = function (val) {
        let vpaid = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]
        broadcastEvent(vpaid.handlers, EVENTS.loadStateChanged, val);
    };
    bridge.setvdPlayCurrentTime = function (val) {
        let vpaid = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]
        broadcastEvent(vpaid.handlers, EVENTS.currentTime, val);
    };
    bridge.setvdPlayToEnd = function (val) {
        let vpaid = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]
        broadcastEvent(vpaid.handlers, EVENTS.playEnd, val);
    };
    bridge.setvdPlayError = function (val) {
        let vpaid = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]
        broadcastEvent(vpaid.handlers, EVENTS.error, val);
    };
    bridge.onChangeFired = function (val) {
        let obj = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId];
        broadcastEvent(obj.handlers, val.event, val.args);
    };
    bridge.notify = function (val) {
        console.log(val)
        if (val.event.startsWith('fire_')) {
            broadcastEvent(listeners, val.event)
            return
        }

        if (val.event.startsWith('dispatch_')) {
            broadcastEvent(listeners, val.event)
            mraid.removeEventListener(val.event);
            return
        }

        if (val.event.startsWith('animation_')) {
            broadcastEvent(listeners, val.event)
            mraid.removeEventListener(val.event);
            return
        }

        broadcastEvent(listeners, val.event, val.message)
        mraid.removeEventListener(val.event);
    };
    bridge.notifyPageChangeEvent = function (val) {
        broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.pageChanged, val)
    };
    bridge.notifyApkDownloadStateEvent = function (val) {
        broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.downloadStateChanged, val)
    };
    bridge.setWVFinished = function (val) {
        let web = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]
        broadcastEvent(web.handlers, EVENTS.ready);
    };
    bridge.setWVError = function (val) {
        let web = bridge.queue[val.uniqueId]
        broadcastEvent(web.handlers, EVENTS.error, val.error);
    };
    bridge.postMessage = function (msg) {
        var msgStr = JSON.stringify(msg);
        sigandroid.postMessage(msgStr);
    }
    bridge.syncMessage = function (msg) {
        if (this.nativeCallInFlight) {
            this.nativeCallQueue.push(msg)
        } else {
            this.nativeCallInFlight = true;
            var msgStr = JSON.stringify(msg);
            sigandroid.postMessage(msgStr);
        }
    }
    bridge.nativeCallComplete = function (command) {
        console.log('nativeCallCompletecommand = ' + command)
        if (this.nativeCallQueue.length === 0) {
            this.nativeCallInFlight = false;
            return
        }
        var nextCall = this.nativeCallQueue.shift();
        bridge.postMessage(nextCall);
    };

    var Storage = function (type) {
        this.setItem = function (key, value) {

    var EventListeners = function (event) {
        this.event = event;
        this.count = 0;
        var listeners = {};
        this.add = function (func) {
            var id = String(func);
            if (!listeners[id]) {
                listeners[id] = func;
                this.count++
            }
        };
        this.remove = function (func) {
            var id = String(func);
            if (listeners[id]) {
                listeners[id] = null;
                delete listeners[id];
                this.count--;
                return true
            } else {
                return false
            }
        };
        this.removeAll = function () {
            for (var id in listeners) {
                if (listeners.hasOwnProperty(id)) this.remove(listeners[id])
            }
        };
        this.broadcast = function (args) {
            for (var id in listeners) {
                if (listeners.hasOwnProperty(id)) listeners[id].apply(mraid, args)
            }
        };
        this.toString = function () {
            var out = [event, ':'];
            for (var id in listeners) {
                if (listeners.hasOwnProperty(id)) out.push('|', id, '|')
            }
            return out.join('')
        }
    };
    var contains = function (value, array) {
        if (value.indexOf('motion_') == 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (value.indexOf('storage_') == 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (value.indexOf('fire_') == 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (value.indexOf('dispatch_') == 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (value.indexOf('animation_') == 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (value.indexOf('open_') == 0) {
            return true;
        }
        if (value.indexOf('lance_') == 0) {
            return true;
        }

        for (var i in array) {
            if (array[i] === value) return true
        }
        return false
    };
    var broadcastEvent = function () {
        var args = new Array(arguments.length);
        var l = arguments.length;
        for (var i = 0; i < l; i++) args[i] = arguments[i];
        var handlers = args.shift();
        var event = args.shift();
        if (handlers[event]) {
            handlers[event].broadcast(args)
        }
    };
    var addEventListener = function (handlers, event, listener) {
        if (!event || !listener) {
            broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.error, 'Both event and listener are required.', 'addEventListener')
        } else {
            if (!handlers[event]) {
                handlers[event] = new EventListeners(event)
            }
            handlers[event].add(listener)
        }
    };
    var removeEventListener = function (funs, event, listener) {
        if (!event) {
            broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.error, 'Event is required.', 'removeEventListener');
            return
        }
        if (listener) {
            var success = false;
            if (funs[event]) {
                success = funs[event].remove(listener)
            }
            if (!success) {
                broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.error, 'Listener not currently registered for event.', 'removeEventListener');
                return
            }
        } else if (funs && funs[event]) {
            funs[event].removeAll()
        }
        if (funs[event] && funs[event].count === 0) {
            funs[event] = null;
            delete funs[event]
        }
    };

    function callNativeFunc(kwargs, func) {
        if (kwargs === undefined) return undefined;
        if (func === undefined) return undefined;
        kwargs['func'] = func;
        var returnStr = sigandroid.func(JSON.stringify(kwargs));
        if (returnStr) {
            try {
                return JSON.parse(returnStr)
            } catch (e) {
                return JSON.stringify(returnStr)
            }
        } else {
            console.log('-------callNativeFunc return null-----');
        }
    };

   mraid.subscribe = function(uniqId, event, listener) {
        if (isNullOrEmpty(uniqId) || isNullOrEmpty(event)) {
            broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.error, 'Both event and uniqId are required.', 'subscribe');
            return;
        }
        let key = uniqId + '~' + event;
        addEventListener(listeners, key, listener);
        if (listeners[key] && listeners[key].count == 1) {
            bridge.syncMessage({ event: 'subscribe', args: { uniqId, event } });
        }
    };
    mraid.unsubscribe = function(uniqId, event, listener) {
        if (isNullOrEmpty(uniqId) || isNullOrEmpty(event)) {
            broadcastEvent(listeners, EVENTS.error, 'Both event and uniqId are required.', 'unsubscribe');
            return;
        }
        let key = uniqId + '~' + event;
        removeEventListener(listeners, key, listener);
        if (isNullOrEmpty(listeners[key])) {
            bridge.syncMessage({ event: 'unsubscribe', args: { uniqId, event } });
        }
    };

     var sendCustomEvent = function() {
         var args = new Array();
         var l = arguments.length;
         for (var i = 0; i < l; i++) {
             var obj = arguments[i];
             if (obj === null) continue;
             if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
                 args = args.concat(obj)
             } else {
                 args.push(obj)
             }
         }
         args.unshift('event');
         args.unshift('smextension');
         executeNativeCall(args)
     };
     var executeNativeCall = function(args) {
         var command = args.shift();
         var call = 'xxx://' + command;
         var key, value;
         var isFirstArgument = true;
         for (var i = 0; i < args.length; i += 2) {
             key = args[i];
             value = args[i + 1];
             if (value === null) continue;
             if (isFirstArgument) {
                 call += '?';
                 isFirstArgument = false
             } else {
                 call += '&'
             }
             call += encodeURIComponent(key) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(value)
         }
         iframeSendSrc(call)
     };
     var iframeSendSrc = function(src) {
         var iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
         iframe.setAttribute('src', src);
         document.documentElement.appendChild(iframe);
         iframe.parentNode.removeChild(iframe);
         iframe = null
     }

             return JSON.parse(returnStr)
         } else {
             kwargs['func'] = func;
             var returnStr = sigandroid.func(JSON.stringify(kwargs));
             return JSON.parse(returnStr)
         }

     var EventListeners = function(event) {
         this.event = event;
         this.count = 0;
         var listeners = {};
         this.add = function(func) {
             var id = String(func);
             if (!listeners[id]) {
                 listeners[id] = func;
                 this.count++
             }
         };
         this.remove = function(func) {
             var id = String(func);
             if (listeners[id]) {
                 listeners[id] = null;
                 delete listeners[id];
                 this.count--;
                 return true
             } else {
                 return false
             }
         };
         this.removeAll = function() {
             for (var id in listeners) {
                 if (listeners.hasOwnProperty(id)) this.remove(listeners[id])
             }
         };
         this.broadcast = function(args) {
             for (var id in listeners) {
                 if (listeners.hasOwnProperty(id)) listeners[id].apply(mraid, args)
             }
         };
         this.toString = function() {
             var out = [event, ':'];
             for (var id in listeners) {
                 if (listeners.hasOwnProperty(id)) out.push('|', id, '|')
             }
             return out.join('')
         }
     };
     var broadcastEvent = function() {
         var args = new Array(arguments.length);
         var l = arguments.length;
         for (var i = 0; i < l; i++) args[i] = arguments[i];
         var event = args.shift();
         if (listeners[event]) listeners[event].broadcast(args)
     };
     xxx.addEventListener = function(event, listener) {
         if (!event || !listener) {
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'Both event and listener are required.', 'addEventListener')
         } else {
             if (!listeners[event]) {
                 listeners[event] = new EventListeners(event)
             }
             listeners[event].add(listener)
         }
     };
     xxx.removeEventListener = function(event, listener) {
         if (!event) {
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'Event is required.', 'removeEventListener');
             return
         }
         if (listener) {
             var success = false;
             if (listeners[event]) {
                 success = listeners[event].remove(listener)
             }
             if (!success) {
                 broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'Listener not currently registered for event.', 'removeEventListener');
                 return
             }
         } else if (!listener && listeners[event]) {
             listeners[event].removeAll()
         }
         if (listeners[event] && listeners[event].count === 0) {
             listeners[event] = null;
             delete listeners[event]
         }
     };

             return

     bridge.executeNativeCall = function(args) {
         var command = args.shift();
         if (!this.nativeSDKFiredReady) {
             console.dclog('rejecting ' + command + ' because mraid is not ready');
             bridge.notifyErrorEvent('mraid is not ready', command);
             return
         }
         var call = 'mraid://' + command;
         var key, value;
         var isFirstArgument = true;
         for (var i = 0; i < args.length; i += 2) {
             key = args[i];
             value = args[i + 1];
             if (value === null) continue;
             if (isFirstArgument) {
                 call += '?';
                 isFirstArgument = false
             } else {
                 call += '&'
             }
             call += encodeURIComponent(key) + '=' + encodeURIComponent(value)
         }
         if (this.nativeCallInFlight) {
             this.nativeCallQueue.push(call)
         } else {
             this.nativeCallInFlight = true;
             window.location = call
         }

     var stringify = function(obj) {
         if (typeof obj === 'object') {
             var out = [];
             if (obj.push) {
                 for (var p in obj) out.push(obj[p]);
                 return '[' + out.join(',') + ']'
             } else {
                 for (var p in obj) out.push("'" + p + "': " + obj[p]);
                 return '{' + out.join(',') + '}'
             }
         } else return String(obj)
     };

     var validate = function(obj, validators, action, merge) {
         if (!merge) {
             if (obj === null) {
                 broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'Required object not provided.', action);
                 return false
             } else {
                 for (var i in validators) {
                     if (validators.hasOwnProperty(i) && obj[i] === undefined) {
                         broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'Object is missing required property: ' + i, action);
                         return false
                     }
                 }
             }
         }
         for (var prop in obj) {
             var validator = validators[prop];
             var value = obj[prop];
             if (validator && !validator(value)) {
                 broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'Value of property ' + prop + ' is invalid: ' + value, action);
                 return false
             }
         }
         return true
     };

        if (this.nativeCallQueueV2.length === 0) {

    var addEventListener = function(handlers, event, listener) {
        if (!event || !listener) {
            broadcastEvent(EVENTS.error, 'Both event and listener are required.', 'addEventListener')
        } else {
            if (!handlers[event]) {
                handlers[event] = new EventListeners(event)
            }
            handlers[event].add(listener)
        }
    };
    var removeEventListener = function(funs, event, listener) {
        if (!event) {
            broadcastEvent(EVENTS.error, 'Event is required.', 'removeEventListener');
            return
        }
        if (listener) {
            var success = false;
            if (funs[event]) {
                success = funs[event].remove(listener)
            }
            if (!success) {
                broadcastEvent(EVENTS.error, 'Listener not currently registered for event.', 'removeEventListener');
                return
            }
        } else if (funs && funs[event]) {
            console.log('removeAll -- ' + event);
            funs[event].removeAll()
        }
        if (funs[event] && funs[event].count === 0) {
            funs[event] = null;
            delete funs[event]
        }
    };

    var strFromPoint = function(x, y) {return '{' + x + ','+ y + '}';}

        if(!w || !h) {
            broadcastEvent(EVENTS.error, 'x,y,w,h is required!', 'frame');
        }else {
            bridge.syncMessage({event: event, subEvent: 'frame', args: {uniqueId: uniqId, frame: {x: x, y: y, w: w, h: h}}});        }
    };
     var changeHandlers = {
         onChangeEvent: bridge.onChangeEvent,
         state: function(val) {
             if (state === STATES.LOADING) {
                 broadcastEvent(EVENTS.INFO, 'Native SDK initialized.')
             }
             state = val;
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.INFO, 'Set state to ' + stringify(val));
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.STATECHANGE, state)
         },
         exposureChange: function(val) {
             console.dclog('mraid.js exposureChange');
             if (val.hasOwnProperty('exposedPercentage')) {
                 var exposedPercentage = val['exposedPercentage']
             }
             if (val.hasOwnProperty('visibleRectangle')) {
                 var visibleRectangle = val['visibleRectangle']
             }
             if (val.hasOwnProperty('occlusionRectangles')) {
                 var occlusionRectangles = val['occlusionRectangles']
             }
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.EXPOSURECHANGE, exposedPercentage, visibleRectangle, occlusionRectangles)
         },
         viewable: function(val) {
             isViewable = val;
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.INFO, 'Set isViewable to ' + stringify(val));
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.VIEWABLECHANGE, isViewable)
         },
         placementType: function(val) {
             placementType = val
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.INFO, 'Set placementType to ' + stringify(val));
         },
         sizeChange: function(val) {
             for (var key in val) {
                 if (val.hasOwnProperty(key)) screenSize[key] = val[key]
             }
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.INFO, 'Set screenSize to ' + stringify(val));
         },
         supports: function(val) {
             supportProperties = val
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.INFO, 'Set supports to ' + stringify(val));
         },
         env: function(val) {
             MRAID_ENV = val
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.INFO, 'Set MRAID_ENV to ' + stringify(val));
         },
         location: function(val) {
             location = val
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.INFO, 'Set location to ' + stringify(val));
         },
         appOrientation: function(val) {
             currentAppOrientation = val
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.INFO, 'Set appOrientation to ' + stringify(val));
         },
         hostSDKVersion: function(val) {
             var versions = val.split('.').map(function(version) {
                 return parseInt(version, 10)
             }).filter(function(version) {
                 return version >= 0
             });
             if (versions.length >= 3) {
                 hostSDKVersion['major'] = parseInt(versions[0], 10);
                 hostSDKVersion['minor'] = parseInt(versions[1], 10);
                 hostSDKVersion['patch'] = parseInt(versions[2], 10);
                 broadcastEvent(EVENTS.INFO, 'Set hostSDKVersion to ' + stringify(hostSDKVersion))
             }
         },
        motionChanged: bridge.onMotionChanged,
        onChangeFired: bridge.onChangeFired,
     };

     mraid.open = function(URL) {
         var args = new Array();
         var l = arguments.length;
         for (var i = 0; i < l; i++) {
             var obj = arguments[i];
             args.push(obj)
         }
         args.shift();
         if (!URL) broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'URL is required.', 'open');
         else {
             var ln = args.length;
             if (ln == 0) bridge.executeNativeCall(['open', 'url', URL]);
             var ext = args[ln - 1];
             bridge.executeNativeCall(['open', 'url', URL, 'ext', JSON.stringify(ext)])
         }
     };
     mraid.removeEventListener = function(event, listener) {
         if (!event) {
             broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'Event is required.', 'removeEventListener');
             return
         }
         if (listener) {
             var success = false;
             if (listeners[event]) {
                 success = listeners[event].remove(listener)
             }
             if (!success) {
                 broadcastEvent(EVENTS.ERROR, 'Listener not currently registered for event.', 'removeEventListener');
                 return
             }
         } else if (!listener && listeners[event]) {
             listeners[event].removeAll()
         }
         if (listeners[event] && listeners[event].count === 0) {
             listeners[event] = null;
             delete listeners[event]
         }
     };

     var resizePropertyValidators = {
         width: function(v) {
             return !isNaN(v) && v > 0
         },
         height: function(v) {
             return !isNaN(v) && v > 0
         },
         offsetX: function(v) {
             return !isNaN(v)
         },
         offsetY: function(v) {
             return !isNaN(v)
         },
         customClosePosition: function(v) {
             return (typeof v === 'string' && ['top-right', 'bottom-right', 'top-left', 'bottom-left', 'center', 'top-center', 'bottom-center'].indexOf(v) > -1)
         },
         allowOffscreen: function(v) {
             return (typeof v === 'boolean')
         }
     };

     mraid.setResizeProperties = function(properties) {
         if (validate(properties, resizePropertyValidators, 'setResizeProperties', true)) {
             var desiredProperties = ['width', 'height', 'offsetX', 'offsetY', 'customClosePosition', 'allowOffscreen'];
             var length = desiredProperties.length;
             for (var i = 0; i < length; i++) {

     var CalendarEventParser = {
         initialize: function(parameters) {
             this.parameters = parameters;
             this.errors = [];
             this.arguments = ['createCalendarEvent']
         },
         parse: function() {
             if (!this.parameters) {
                 this.errors.push('The object passed to createCalendarEvent cannot be null.')
             } else {
                 this.parseDescription();
                 this.parseLocation();
                 this.parseSummary();
                 this.parseStartAndEndDates();
                 this.parseReminder();
                 this.parseRecurrence();
                 this.parseTransparency()
             }
             var errorCount = this.errors.length;
             if (errorCount) {
                 this.arguments.length = 0
             }
             return (errorCount === 0)
         },
         parseDescription: function() {
             this._processStringValue('description')
         },
         parseLocation: function() {
             this._processStringValue('location')
         },
         parseSummary: function() {
             this._processStringValue('summary')
         },
         parseStartAndEndDates: function() {
             this._processDateValue('start');
             this._processDateValue('end')
         },
         parseReminder: function() {
             var reminder = this._getParameter('reminder');
             if (!reminder) {
                 return
             }
             if (reminder < 0) {
                 this.arguments.push('relativeReminder');
                 this.arguments.push(parseInt(reminder) / 1000)
             } else {
                 this.arguments.push('absoluteReminder');
                 this.arguments.push(reminder)
             }
         },
         parseRecurrence: function() {
             var recurrenceDict = this._getParameter('recurrence');
             if (!recurrenceDict) {
                 return
             }
             this.parseRecurrenceInterval(recurrenceDict);
             this.parseRecurrenceFrequency(recurrenceDict);
             this.parseRecurrenceEndDate(recurrenceDict);
             this.parseRecurrenceArrayValue(recurrenceDict, 'daysInWeek');
             this.parseRecurrenceArrayValue(recurrenceDict, 'daysInMonth');
             this.parseRecurrenceArrayValue(recurrenceDict, 'daysInYear');
             this.parseRecurrenceArrayValue(recurrenceDict, 'monthsInYear')
         },
         parseTransparency: function() {
             var validValues = ['opaque', 'transparent'];
             if (this.parameters.hasOwnProperty('transparency')) {
                 var transparency = this.parameters.transparency;
                 if (contains(transparency, validValues)) {
                     this.arguments.push('transparency');
                     this.arguments.push(transparency)
                 } else {
                     this.errors.push('transparency must be opaque or transparent')
                 }
             }
         },
         parseRecurrenceArrayValue: function(recurrenceDict, kind) {
             if (recurrenceDict.hasOwnProperty(kind)) {
                 var array = recurrenceDict[kind];
                 if (!array || !(array instanceof Array)) {
                     this.errors.push(kind + ' must be an array.')
                 } else {
                     var arrayStr = array.join(',');
                     this.arguments.push(kind);
                     this.arguments.push(arrayStr)
                 }
             }
         },
         parseRecurrenceInterval: function(recurrenceDict) {
             if (recurrenceDict.hasOwnProperty('interval')) {
                 var interval = recurrenceDict.interval;
                 if (!interval) {
                     this.errors.push('Recurrence interval cannot be null.')
                 } else {
                     this.arguments.push('interval');
                     this.arguments.push(interval)
                 }
             } else {
                 this.arguments.push('interval');
                 this.arguments.push(1)
             }
         },
         parseRecurrenceFrequency: function(recurrenceDict) {
             if (recurrenceDict.hasOwnProperty('frequency')) {
                 var frequency = recurrenceDict.frequency;
                 var validFrequencies = ['daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'yearly'];
                 if (contains(frequency, validFrequencies)) {
                     this.arguments.push('frequency');
                     this.arguments.push(frequency)
                 } else {
                     this.errors.push('Recurrence frequency must be one of: "daily", "weekly", "monthly", "yearly".')
                 }
             }
         },
         parseRecurrenceEndDate: function(recurrenceDict) {
             var expires = recurrenceDict.expires;
             if (!expires) {
                 return
             }
             this.arguments.push('expires');
             this.arguments.push(expires)
         },
         _getParameter: function(key) {
             if (this.parameters.hasOwnProperty(key)) {
                 return this.parameters[key]
             }
             return null
         },
         _processStringValue: function(kind) {
             if (this.parameters.hasOwnProperty(kind)) {
                 var value = this.parameters[kind];
                 this.arguments.push(kind);
                 this.arguments.push(value)
             }
         },
         _processDateValue: function(kind) {
             if (this.parameters.hasOwnProperty(kind)) {
                 var dateString = this._getParameter(kind);
                 this.arguments.push(kind);
                 this.arguments.push(dateString)
             }
         }
     }
